description: November 1, 2025 Chiaradio Donates to Food Banks Amid SNAP Crisis STARKVILLE, MS — Congressional candidate Michael A. Chiaradio announced today that his campaign has donated to Starkville Strong and Truevine Pantry, two vital food programs serving families in Starkville and Flowood, Mississippi. The donations come at a critical time, as many families across the state face uncertainty due to Republican-led threats to federal nutrition programs. Chiaradio emphasized that his campaign is not just about politics, but about helping real people. “The difference could not be more clear,” Chiaradio said. “My opponent, Mindless Michael Guest, is holding fake Town Halls on his telephone and posting photos with his donors. Meanwhile, we’re out here making real investments in the community.” Chiaradio’s campaign continues to focus on grassroots action and mutual aid, using direct community investment to strengthen trust and build turnout across Mississippi’s 3rd District. Supporters who want to help Chiaradio expand these mutual aid efforts can donate today at: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-a-chiaradio
title: Chiaradio Donates to Food Banks Amid SNAP Crisis - Michael A Chiaradio
